name: Shirobara no Namae
source:
Masaki Yuu who works for the detective office is entrusted with  training three new girls as detectives within a year time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在侦探事务所工作的正木优受托在一年内将三名新女孩训练成侦探。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
